generate_reshape_noop: generate reshape ops for a no-op einshape equation like 'i->i' with a given input shape
generate_transpose_ops: generate transpose ops to reorder tensor axes using an einshape equation like 'ij->ji'
generate_nchw_transpose: generate ops to convert NHWC tensor layout to NCHW using the einshape engine
generate_squeeze_expand: generate ops to squeeze unit dimensions or expand dims using einshape equations like 'j1k->jk'
generate_broadcast_tile: generate broadcast ops to tile a tensor along new axes using an einshape equation like 'j->nj'
